approval.evidence: Owner's answers on 2026-11-11 to the questions put after REP-101: Fix now? "Wait for everything". $0 rule: "Top up to $5 if shelf empty (Recommended)". Balance set: "Show me each change first", then ticked: "Tip Jar pays more often, Nest Egg starts with $15, Sharp Ears $2 from 3 stalls, Fix how Normal computers price"; "New costs, Ripening Room: cheaper green mango, Order Book: $2 more a piece"; "Green mango costs $4, Bargain blueberry pays $4, Fix two lorry rows, More apples on lorries". Standing orders: first "lets think about reworking this mechanism, or should it stay", then "Stake instead of fines (Recommended)". Rival buys: "Show today's buys (Recommended)". Day 1: first "im leaning more towards only delaying mango customers", then "Delay mango customers only". Text voice: "Plain, with a Malaysian market feel". Empty steps, ticked: "Skip Stocking with nothing ripe, Evening only when you have a choice, Faster rush" (not ticked: buying ends itself at the limit). Rule gaps: "Go through them one by one", then ticked: "Juice Bar: rush sales only, Premium Display: not on guests, Sharp Ears: evening, once a day, Priority beats Nest Egg"; "Final tie is shared, One favour deck of 12, Event fixes (tested first)"; on Favoured Trade: "give the pros and cons for each option for favoured trades before the flip" (open). Trophies: "Change them to fit the rules (Recommended)". Printed freshness tracking: "Mock up options 1 and 2 first" (open).

title: Rules version 18: build the approved balance set, the top-up, staked standing orders and the rulings
problem: REP-101 found stalls knocked out at $0, two shopkeepers and three upgrades out of balance, the mango as the default buy, a standing-order fine that a broke winner does not pay, purchases that must be memorised, mango customers nobody can serve on days 1 and 2, and several rule gaps. The owner approved the changes in DEC-086.
scope: src/engine (data, game, ai), src/net/protocol.ts (rules and computer-player versions), server/room.ts (what each phone may see)
The smallest screen changes the new rules need (standing-order stake, today's buys on rival boxes, the top-up line, skipped steps)
RULES.md, tests, a simulation of the built rules against the targets
exclusions: The text rewrite (DEC-087), the screen and card redesign, the trophies and the print kit: later packages
When Favoured Trade is played on the table and how freshness is tracked on the table: open decisions

acceptance.text: npm run verify passes with tests for each rule change
